11: // A Driver implements Rego query execution of Templates and Constraints.
12: type Driver interface {
13: 	// Name returns the name of the driver, used to uniquely identify a driver
14: 	// and in errors returned to the user.
15: 	Name() string
16: 
17: 	// AddTemplate compiles a Template's code to be specified by
18: 	// Constraints and referenced in Query. Replaces the existing Template if it
19: 	// already exists.
20: 	AddTemplate(ctx context.Context, ct *templates.ConstraintTemplate) error
21: 	// RemoveTemplate removes the Template from the Driver, and any Constraints.
22: 	// Does not return an error if the Template does not exist.
23: 	RemoveTemplate(ctx context.Context, ct *templates.ConstraintTemplate) error
24: 
25: 	// AddConstraint adds a Constraint to Driver for a particular Template. Future
26: 	// calls to Query may reference the added Constraint. Replaces the existing
27: 	// Constraint if it already exists.
28: 	AddConstraint(ctx context.Context, constraint *unstructured.Unstructured) error
29: 	// RemoveConstraint removes a Constraint from Driver. Future calls to Query
30: 	// may not reference the removed Constraint.
31: 	// Does not return error if the Constraint does not exist.
32: 	RemoveConstraint(ctx context.Context, constraint *unstructured.Unstructured) error
33: 
34: 	// AddData caches data to be used for referential Constraints. Replaces data
35: 	// if it already exists at the specified path. This is a deprecated method that
36: 	// will only be called for the "Rego" driver.
37: 	AddData(ctx context.Context, target string, path storage.Path, data interface{}) error
38: 	// RemoveData removes cached data, so the data at the specified path can no
39: 	// longer be used in referential Constraints. This is a deprecated method that
40: 	// will only be called for the "Rego" driver.
41: 	RemoveData(ctx context.Context, target string, path storage.Path) error
42: 
43: 	// Query runs the passed target's Constraints against review.
44: 	// Returns a QueryResponse type.
45: 	// Returns an error if there was a problem executing the Query.
46: 	Query(ctx context.Context, target string, constraints []*unstructured.Unstructured, review interface{}, opts ...Opt) (*QueryResponse, error)
47: 
48: 	// Dump outputs the entire state of compiled Templates, added Constraints, and
49: 	// cached data used for referential Constraints.
50: 	Dump(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
51: }
52: 
53: // ConstraintKey uniquely identifies a Constraint.
54: type ConstraintKey struct {
55: 	Kind string `json:"kind"`
56: 	Name string `json:"name"`
57: }
58: 
59: // ConstraintKeyFrom returns a unique identifier corresponding to Constraint.
60: func ConstraintKeyFrom(constraint *unstructured.Unstructured) ConstraintKey {
61: 	return ConstraintKey{
62: 		Kind: constraint.GetKind(),
63: 		Name: constraint.GetName(),
64: 	}
65: }
66: 
67: // StoragePath returns a unique path in Rego storage for Constraint's parameters.
68: // Constraints have a single set of parameters shared among all targets, so a
69: // target-specific path is not required.
70: func (k ConstraintKey) StoragePath() storage.Path {
71: 	return storage.Path{"constraints", k.Kind, k.Name}
72: }
